The '''Com-Repeater''' was a sensor scrambler employed by [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]] of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].

==Characteristics==
A Com-Repeater was capable of fouling any sensors within 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of the device. It was small enough to be placed into a [[MSE-series]] mouse [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] cargo compartment, which was a favorite trick of Infiltrators.
